title: The Patrol Route
mission: Predict the order the guards walk the rooms
concept: Preorder, inorder, postorder and level order
briefing: The blueprint wing holds no treasure worth taking, but it holds the patrol schedule. The rooms carry arbitrary numbers - there is no left-is-smaller rule here, only shape. A preorder patrol reads a room, then everything to its left, then everything to its right. Call the route correctly, room by room, and the guards will never know you were watching.
hints: Preorder is root, then the whole left subtree, then the whole right subtree - and the same rule applies again inside each subtree.
Start at the entrance. From any room, go as deep left as you can before you ever turn right.
Show me the patrol replays the real traversal, but it costs you a star.
